meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and when?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
Students misquote all the time. Show me the page in his essay, and the act and scene you checked.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
Be very careful with your next sentence, Hale. Claire won her appeal, and you've just told me Owen was judged before this meeting started. I'll be taking that to the principal tonight.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology, and the page of his essay with the line you say is not in Hamlet, along with the act and scene you checked. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see the line in his essay with the act and scene you checked, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Owning the missed phone call in one sentence and moving on earned you a small sign of ground, because it admitted the process failure without arguing it.
What cost ground: Bringing up her daughter's old case and suggesting it runs in the family, because it attacked the family instead of the essay and sent her straight toward the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since nothing about times or late nights was raised; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she demanded the page and the act and scene, put the essay page in front of her and let her search the play herself, and leave her daughter out of the meeting entirely.
